summary: The root رصص (rSS) primarily means to make something compact, firm, or closely joined together. It implies a solid, well-arranged structure, like bricks or stones fitted tightly, leaving no gaps.

provenance.lane: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon (1863-93), public domain. Digital text via Perseus, Tufts University, CC BY-SA 3.0 US.
